description: Norway's register of releases to air and water and waste transfers by facility. The Norske utslipp site says it shows releases from different sectors both aggregated and at facility level, including annual releases from facilities that report to the Norwegian Environment Agency and the county governors, with sections for wastewater treatment plants, landfills, land-based industry and offshore petroleum, plus permits and inspection reports per facility. It lists facilities with permits by county and by sector, for example 1,226 land-based, 1,068 waste and 181 offshore, and a new display solution is being built in 2026. It is free to browse online. Coverage is Norway. Caveats: the licence and bulk download options are not stated on the pages read, and the site needs JavaScript. For simulation it locates industrial and offshore facilities with their permits and emissions, for exposure and consequence mapping. A related catalogue record is the EU Industrial Emissions Portal.
